sources.sections: Passenger-state navigation; arriving; departing; transiting; visiting; Fly; At Changi; Dine & Shop; Experience; App & Help
sources.title: Changi Airport
sources.note: Primary institutional-discovery source. The airport explicitly separates arriving, departing, transiting and visiting user states and presents flight, terminal, hospitality, retail, attraction and assistance functions within one airport-facing ecosystem.

sources.sections: Transit eligibility; same-itinerary requirement; through-checked baggage; onward boarding pass; transfer desks; security; transit hotels; lounges; rest areas; attractions
sources.title: Transit Guide at Changi Airport
sources.note: Core transit-state source. Transit eligibility depends on itinerary and baggage state; passengers without onward boarding passes are directed to transfer desks; onward passengers still pass security before the next gate.

sources.sections: Jewel access; public versus transit areas; Skytrain; link bridges; T4 public shuttle; T4 transit shuttle; through-checked requirement; operating hours
sources.title: Transfer Between Terminals & Jewel
sources.note: Primary spatial-state source. Jewel is in the public area and transit passengers must clear arrival immigration to visit it. Public and transit inter-terminal routes differ, and transit transfer to T4 depends on through-checked status.

sources.sections: T1 transit hotel; T2 transit hotel; T3 transit hotel; Jewel YOTELAIR; public/transit labels; immigration boundary; operating hours; booking
sources.title: Changi Airport Transit Hotels
sources.note: Accommodation-state source. T1/T2/T3 hotel inventory is located in transit areas while YOTELAIR is listed at Jewel. The transit-hotel guidance explicitly tells qualifying guests not to clear immigration before using the airside hotel.

sources.sourceDate: Current lounge page and rates inspected 2026-10-20
sources.sections: T4 transit location; lounge rates; boarding-pass/travel-pass/credit-card access; capacity; food and beverage; showers; operator contact
sources.title: Blossom – SATS & Plaza Premium Lounge
sources.note: Representative lounge-entitlement source. Access is not limited to premium cabin class; walk-in entry can rely on several credential/payment routes, but remains capacity-dependent and requires the relevant transit-area state.

sources.sections: T2 public area; non-traveller access; boarding-pass discount; pay-per-use showers; gym; fitness; bicycle rental; café and bar
sources.title: Hub & Spoke
sources.note: Public-area comparison source. The facility is available to non-flyers, while eligible travellers can receive a separate benefit by presenting a valid boarding pass or itinerary within the stated time window.

sources.sections: Care@Changi; airline advance arrangements; Special Assistance immigration lanes; Care Ambassadors; information counters; onboard medical assistance
sources.title: Special Assistance & Traveller Accessibility Support
sources.note: Responsibility-boundary source. Changi provides airport assistance infrastructure and Care Ambassadors, while travellers needing specified onboard or pre-arranged assistance are directed to coordinate with their airline.

sources.sections: Barrier-free MRT access; ramps; lifts; accessible toilets; tactile guidance; audio/visual information; service animals; related Care@Changi services
sources.title: Travelling with Reduced Mobility
sources.note: Accessibility-journey source. Public transport and airport-related movement expose several accessibility states and assistance mechanisms, but the page does not verify live fulfilment for an individual passenger.

sources.sections: Transit eligibility; layover duration; immigration constraint; entry visa; through-checked baggage; registration; capacity; tour timing; baggage storage; return responsibility
sources.title: Free Singapore Tours
sources.note: Strong entitlement-state source. A transit passenger can become eligible for a city experience only if flight, layover, baggage, immigration and documentation states align; eligibility does not equal unlimited availability.

sources.sections: Dining inventory; terminal; public/transit location filters; operating hours; dietary preference filters; outlet categories
sources.title: Dining Directory: Restaurants & Food
sources.note: Dining-discovery source. Airport dining is distributed across terminals, Jewel, public and transit areas rather than constituting one universally accessible dining inventory.

sources.sections: Real-time flight updates; attractions; dining reservations; payments; rewards; account; flight saving; baggage tracking; bookings
sources.title: Changi App
sources.note: Digital-journey source. The app combines flight information, attraction booking, dining reservations, payments, rewards, account state and baggage tracking but does not establish that every underlying service shares one operational system.

sources.sections: Departure tracking; arrival tracking; transfer tracking; participating airlines; first/last bag; airline information; airport baggage-system information
sources.title: Baggage Tracker on Changi App
sources.note: Baggage-state source. Tracking spans departure, arrival and transfer but depends on participating airlines and combines airline-provided information with Changi Airport baggage-system information.

sources.sections: Flight status; airline contacts; ground handlers; airline lost baggage; airport lost and found; general feedback; Jewel enquiries; partner follow-up
sources.title: Changi Airport Contact Information
sources.note: Recovery-ownership source. Flight/baggage matters can route to airlines or ground handlers, airport-premises lost property follows an airport route, and Jewel enquiries have a separate contact path.

sources.sections: Arrival/departure status; real-time updates; delays; cancellations; airline responsibility; destination requirements; recommended arrival timing
sources.title: Flight Information: Arrivals & Departures
sources.note: Disruption-information source. Changi provides real-time airport flight information while directing passengers to their airline for the most current rescheduling or compensation information.

sources.sourceDate: Undated; current Jewel traveller page inspected 2026-10-20
sources.sections: Jewel attractions; dining; YOTELAIR; baggage storage; early check-in; participating airlines; concierge; GST refund
sources.title: Traveller's Information - Jewel Changi Airport
sources.note: Jewel participation source. Public-area hospitality includes attractions, hotel, dining, baggage storage and early check-in, but individual services can have their own access, luggage and airline-eligibility conditions.

sources.sections: CAG Group; identity; payment; physical access; immigration-related data; customer touchpoints; airlines; government agencies; service providers; lounge operators; Jewel
sources.title: Changi Airport Privacy Policy
sources.note: Data-relationship source. CAG identifies passenger and physical-access data and describes potential information relationships across CAG Group entities, airlines, government agencies, lounge operators, concessionaires and service providers.

sources.sections: Airport/air-carrier responsibilities; reduced-capacity operations; passenger contact; disruption management; welfare; food; accommodation; re-ticketing; lost-baggage arrangements
sources.title: CAG Conditions of Use 2017
sources.note: Role-boundary document. It places specified disruption-management, passenger welfare, accommodation, re-ticketing and lost-baggage planning obligations on air carriers while also describing CAG control responsibilities. The document is dated 2017 and is not treated as proof that every current operational procedure is unchanged.
